source: @remotion/motion-blur@4.0.537 with remotion@4.0.537 and @remotion/player@4.0.537 Thumbnail, react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup, executed in Node
method: Composition 100x100, 30 fps, 30 frames. The child is a probe printing "<frame>/<durationInFrames>" as each layer sees them; the component sits in a layout="none" Sequence starting at "from". "markup" is the component's markup with the AbsoluteFill base style replaced by "AF"; the replay must match it exactly. Props "NaN"/"Infinity" strings stand for those numbers. Skipped as known divergences: {"tie":3,"sequenceEndClamp":85,"zeroSamplesAtZero":13}. tie: the reference layer count at an exact half-integer frame/shutter ratio flips with float noise that depends on samples. sequenceEndClamp: inside a Sequence the reference clamps layer frames to the composition's last frame, the replay to the Sequence's last frame. zeroSamplesAtZero: the reference throws "Invalid array length" for samples 0 at local frame 0 and renders one layer at later frames; the replay renders one layer at frame 0 too.
